subject.title: fix(memory): hide QMD transport metadata from recalled content

question: Must this PR safely repair existing contaminated QMD recall entries before closing the linked bug, or should its scope be narrowed to new recalls with legacy cleanup tracked separately?
rationale: Stored recall entries do not appear to carry backend provenance, while generic recalled text may legitimately begin with the same diff-hunk syntax, so the acceptable upgrade scope cannot be inferred safely from shape alone.

options.title: Add verified legacy repair
options.body: Require an idempotent source-verified QMD repair path and real repair proof before merge and issue closure.

options.title: Narrow to future recalls
options.body: Merge only after removing the persisted-cleanup claim and keep a canonical follow-up open for safe legacy-state recovery.

recommendation.title: Add verified legacy repair
recommendation.body: Require an idempotent source-verified QMD repair path and real repair proof before merge and issue closure.

likelyOwner.reason: The QMD adapter and Dreaming promotion history both trace to this feature owner, making them the best available person to choose the upgrade boundary.
